findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file usage
 * @description Using insecure temporary file operations can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file-dotenv
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp", "TemporaryFile", "NamedTemporaryFile"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially insecure temporary file usage."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure temporary file operations that could lead to race conditions or information disclosure

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name TOCTOU race condition in file operations
 * @description Checking file existence followed by file operation can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/toctou-race-dotenv
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode existsCheck, DataFlow::CallCfgNode fileOp
where
  existsCheck = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("exists").getACall() and
  (
    fileOp = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    fileOp = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rename"]).getACall()
  )
select existsCheck, "File existence check may be subject to TOCTOU race condition with subsequent file operation."
findings.hypothesis: Time-of-check time-of-use race conditions in file operations
